title: ObsidianService 反向写入 + Frontmatter 映射
action: Add writeNote, updateNote, createNote, deleteNote, readFrontmatter, updateFrontmatter, mergeFrontmatter to ObsidianService; extend IObsidianService interface

changes: Add writeNote(vaultPath, notePath, content): writes content to vault note, creates parent dirs
Add updateNote(vaultPath, notePath, content): reads existing, writes updated, preserves frontmatter if present
Add createNote(vaultPath, notePath, content, frontmatter?): creates new note with optional YAML frontmatter
Add deleteNote(vaultPath, notePath): deletes note file from vault
Add readFrontmatter(vaultPath, notePath): parses and returns YAML frontmatter as object
Add updateFrontmatter(vaultPath, notePath, updates): merges updates into existing frontmatter, preserves body
Add mergeFrontmatter(vaultPath, notePath, data): deep-merge frontmatter fields, write back
Extend IObsidianService with writeNote, updateNote, createNote, deleteNote, readFrontmatter, updateFrontmatter
Add corresponding tests for all new methods

estimated_changes: 150 lines added to obsidian-service.ts, 20 lines to types.ts, 120 lines to test
